name: MonarchDisclosureGroupStyle
title: Accordion
wrapsNative: DisclosureGroup with .disclosureGroupStyle(.monarch) and isExpanded: bindings, separated by MonarchDivider
summary: Stacked sections whose content opens under each header: standard DisclosureGroups with the Monarch style, one shared binding for one-at-a-time or a Set for any number.
whenToUse: For reference content where people look for one item: FAQs, policy sections, help topics, optional detail under a summary.
whenNotToUse: For switching between views of one object, use Picker with .pickerStyle(.segmented) or a TabView. Do not hide content everyone must read, and do not use it for form steps. Inside a List, the system disclosure style fits better.
api: DisclosureGroup(_ titleKey: StringProtocol, isExpanded: Binding<Bool>, content: () -> Content).disclosureGroupStyle(.monarch)
init(expandedLabel: String? = nil, collapsedLabel: String? = nil)  // MonarchDisclosureGroupStyle

options.name: expandedLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in "Expanded" spoken value of every header.

options.name: collapsedLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in "Collapsed" spoken value of every header.

states.name: collapsed
states.description: Only the headers are shown; chevrons point down.

states.name: expanded
states.description: A section's content is shown under its header and its chevron points up. With one String? binding, opening a section closes the open one; with a Set<String> binding any number stay open.

states.name: disabled
states.description: A section with disabled(_:) uses the disabled text colour and does not open.

appearance: Headers use the label type role in the default text colour with a muted chevron; MonarchDivider draws a hairline in the subtle border colour between sections. No boxes or fills, in every theme.
platformNotes: The web Accordion is Radix Accordion with type single or multiple, collapsible and headingAs. On iOS each section is a standard DisclosureGroup with the Monarch style; single or multiple is decided by the binding the app passes (an optional id or a Set of ids), so no accordion type is shipped. Arrow-key movement between headers is not offered; VoiceOver moves between them as separate elements. Android ships a MonarchAccordion type.
accessibility: Each header is a button labelled with the section title, with the value "Expanded" or "Collapsed".
The recipe adds the header trait to each section, so VoiceOver's headings rotor reaches them.
Collapsed content is removed, so VoiceOver does not reach it.
Every header is at least 44 points high; content appears without animation when Reduce Motion is on.
edgeCases: Long titles wrap before the chevron.
With a single optional binding, opening a section closes the open one in the same change.
State held inside a section's content is lost when it collapses.
Whether the header trait added to a DisclosureGroup is read together with the button by VoiceOver was not checked on a device.
